body: Started the portfolio rebuild — Next.js shell, design tokens, and CompanyBrain glass tiers adapted into styles/glass.css.
Hardening the Graph RAG chat path: SSE streaming, retrieval provenance in the UI, and admin surfaces for latency and routing.
Factory attendance still in daily use — spent a week on report edge cases around shift-change exceptions.
Mapped DesiFit data flows against DPDP purpose limitation — cut half the planned analytics events before they became liabilities.
Qdrant hybrid retrieval + graph context wired end to end; started treating observability as part of the product, not an afterthought.
